name: Alexandria
source:
A girl who is hiding parts of her identity. Aloof and wary, she seems unfamiliar with interacting with others her age. Despite that, she warms up to Nick after meeting him at the Summer Festival. She seems to know more about the recent murders than she lets on. Intelligent and quick to tease once comfortable, Nick has to keep his guard up around her.


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603590/The_Ghost_of_Alcantra/]Steam[/url]]
